description: Preview first, 30-day undo. Remove one exact false atom from a bundled memory, retaining the other text and clearing its stale embedding. Reviewed and reversible: first call preview_destructive_change({ tool: "correct_memory_atom", arguments: { memory_id, false_atom } }), which stores the exact change without applying it. After the user confirms, call correct_memory_atom with preview_id, restore_window_acknowledged: true and request_id; the reviewed preview is applied exactly and a changed record is refused. Returns restore_id; restore_change({ restore_id }) undoes it for 30 days unless the record was edited since. ($0.10; API key required)

memory_id.description: Memory id, checked against the preview.

preview_id.description: preview_id returned by preview_destructive_change for this tool.

request_id.description: Required idempotency key; retries return the original receipt.

restore_window_acknowledged.description: Must be true after reviewing the preview and its 30-day restore window.
